lines.text: Abraham took another wife, named Keturah, and she bore him six sons.
Abraham left everything to Isaac and sent his concubines' sons away with gifts to the land of the south.
Abraham lived 175 years, then died old and contented and was gathered to his people.
Isaac and Ishmael buried Abraham in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre, where his wife Rebekah was also buried.
Ishmael's firstborn son was Nebaioth, and his twelve sons were princes of their tribes.
